# llm-bridge

> LLM Bridge is a local OpenAI-compatible LLM API gateway for Google Antigravity (AGY), multi-account Gemini, Claude Code and Codex CLI logins. It serves OpenAI Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses. Python 3.8+ standard library only. The gateway runs locally; inference requests go to provider cloud services. Named saved accounts currently apply to AGY, with emails/names, per-account selection and independent credential snapshots. Codex and Claude use their active CLI login.

Use it by running `llm-bridge up`, which prints a base URL (`http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1`) and an API key, then point any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible app or agent at it.

## Docs

- [Models & routing](docs/models.md): `provider/model` naming, routing precedence, alias tables
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how AI agents use the bridge as a backend and contribute to the repo
- [Hermes integration](docs/hermes.md)
- [OpenClaw integration](docs/openclaw.md)

## Key facts

- Base URLs: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1` (OpenAI-style), `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (Anthropic SDK)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`; keys via `llm-bridge keys create`
- Endpoints: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `POST /v1/messages`, `POST /v1/responses`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /health`
- Model names: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, `openai/gpt-5.5`, `antigravity/gemini-3.8-flash`
- Install from checkout: `./install.sh`, `pipx install .` or `python3 -m pip install .` (Python 3.8+, no runtime dependencies)
- Account inventory: `llm-bridge accounts list`; includes saved AGY accounts and current CLI logins with email/name when available
- Save/select/remove: `llm-bridge accounts add work`, `accounts use work`, `accounts remove work`
- Per-request account routing: `antigravity@work/gemini-3.8-flash`
- AGY 1.3.1 macOS imports: Keychain detected automatically; explicit token files and legacy files supported
- No fixed AGY account cap; no automatic account switching on quota errors
- Local credential status is not a live access/quota check; use `llm-bridge test provider/model`
- Named AGY refresh requires ANTIGRAVITY_CLIENT_ID and ANTIGRAVITY_CLIENT_SECRET; credentials are not bundled
- Gemini 3.1 Pro High maps to the accepted Pro route with High thinking budget; documented in models.md
- License: MIT
